title: 3473. Sum of K Subarrays With Length at Least M

examples.explanation: The optimal choice is: Subarray nums[3..5] with sum 3 + 3 + 4 = 10 (length is 3 >= m). Subarray nums[0..1] with sum 1 + 2 = 3 (length is 2 >= m). The total sum is 10 + 3 = 13.
The optimal choice is choosing each element as a subarray. The output is (-10) + 3 + (-1) + (-2) = -10.
